recognize_zh: 中央一個巨噬細胞的胞質裡有十來個小點狀物，另有數個散在紅血球之間；每個小體呈「雙點」外觀（核加 kinetoplast），符合骨髓抹片中的 LD bodies。
features: Histiocyte with pale vacuolated cytoplasm containing about a dozen tiny oval organisms
Organisms show a characteristic double-dot appearance (nucleus plus kinetoplast)
Additional free amastigotes scattered between red cells
Background hematopoietic cells including plasma cells, a neutrophil and erythroid precursors
Image somewhat soft-focus; kinetoplast detail best appreciated at higher magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows mixed hematopoietic elements, including plasma cells and neutrophils. A central macrophage contains multiple small oval intracytoplasmic organisms, and similar organisms lie free between red cells. The organisms show a nucleus with an adjacent kinetoplast producing a double-dot appearance, without capsules or budding. Findings are consistent with Leishmania amastigotes (Leishman-Donovan bodies).

ddx.vs: Histoplasma yeasts have a clear halo and budding and lack the paired kinetoplast dot.
Talaromyces shows elongated forms with a central septum from fission rather than a nucleus-kinetoplast pair.
Debris and platelets are irregular in size and shape and lack a uniform oval body with a second small dot.
